title: Constructive Lean 4 Formalization and Exact-Rational Certificates for OpenAI's omega <= 9/4 Strassen Spectral Profile Proof
abstract: OpenAI (Oct. 2, 2026) established the upper bound omega <= 9/4 for the complex matrix multiplication exponent via a compact spectral-profile mechanism: finite 5M -> M Fourier squared-mismatch degeneration (Prop. 3.1), a determinant filtration establishing discrete concavity 2P(a,b) >= P(a,b+1) + P(a,b-1) (Lem. 4.1), a three-sector decomposition giving shifted tripling P(a, 3h+a-1) >= 3P(a,h) (Lem. 4.2), and an elementary discrete growth proof forcing P(a,a) >= a^(4/3) (Lem. 5.1) and thus t <= 3/4 => omega = 3t <= 9/4. We present a standalone, zero-dependency, zero-floating-point verification stack pairing: (i) StrassenNineFourths.lean, 18 constructive Lean 4.35.0 theorems (zero sorry, zero axiom, zero Classical.choice, zero warnings; 1 zero-axiom and 17 [propext, Quot.sound]) mechanizing Proposition 3.1, Lemmas 4.1-4.2, and the complete universal inductive proof of Lemma 5.1 (P(a,a)^3 >= a^4 for all a >= 1) over a self-contained exact-rational structure QRat; and (ii) STRASSEN-94-CERT-1.0, a pure-stdlib Python Fraction auditor across four modes. Alongside certifying 16 canonical witnesses in 0.008-13.686 ms and rejecting 60/60 live adversarial forgeries (64/64 pytest checks), our exact audit reveals a 4x tightening of Proposition 3.1's degeneration degree from (M-1)^2 to floor((M-1)/2)^2 (degree 0 at M=2) and proves exact minimal integer refutation thresholds a*(t) for supercritical exponents t > 3/4.
